Create a fictional educational explainer for CYBERAWARE 3D about Privacy incident response. Scenario: A staff member emails a spreadsheet with personal identifiers to an external recipient with a similar name. The recipient has not yet confirmed deletion. Explain why the correct defensive response is: Notify the privacy/security incident channel promptly, preserve message details, request containment through approved procedures and let authorized roles assess notification obligations. Also contrast the unsafe alternatives using short abstract visual cues. Conclude with: A misdirected data disclosure is an incident to assess even when accidental and even if recall is attempted. Use a generic simulated interface, a navy/cyan 3D cyber-learning environment, legible labels, restrained camera motion, no recognizable logos, no real personal data, no operational attack instructions, no real credentials or live URLs.

VISUAL STYLE
Deep navy and charcoal; restrained cyan/electric-blue highlights; limited purple accents; clean typography; purposeful, low-motion transitions; accessible contrast.

GENERATION INSTRUCTIONS
- Use the narration as the voiceover source; preserve its meaning and do not add unsupported technical claims.
- Render a 16:9 MP4 at 1080p or equivalent; keep text inside safe margins.
- Use only fictional names, domains, screens and values. Never render real secrets, OTPs, account data or real target systems.
- Provide a separate WebVTT caption file and transcript; do not rely on burned-in text alone.
- Use no flashing effects, rapid strobing, unnecessary parallax or autoplay audio.
- Human-review the rendered video for factual accuracy, spelling, pronunciation, captions and timing before marking it validated.
